visualCharacteristics: Section heading on a pale ice (#f4f8fc) band: small grey uppercase eyebrow above a 28/36 px ink title, aligned to the 12-column grid.
contentPattern: One row, one cell: optional eyebrow paragraph(s) followed by a heading (h3); paragraphs before the heading become the eyebrow, the heading and anything after become the title.
usage: Use as the eyebrow-plus-title heading that introduces the acknowledgments/awards card slider on an ice band.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any ice-band section intro that needs a small label over a title; place the card slider block right after it in the same section.
